name: search
description: Full-text search across French legal units. Matches name, sigle, director names, addresses. Returns SIREN, denomination, establishments, sector code (APE/NAF), and basic financials.

postal_code.description: Filter to a 5-digit French postal code

departement.description: Filter to a French département (e.g. "75" Paris, "13" Bouches-du-Rhône)

employee_range.description: Employee count band: NN | 00 | 01 | 02 | 03 | 11 | 12 | 21 | 22 | 31 | 32 | 41 | 42 | 51 | 52 | 53 (Sirene tranche codes)

only_active.description: Restrict to currently active units (default true)

name: get_enterprise
description: Fetch a single legal unit with all its establishments by SIREN (9 digits).

name: nearby
description: List French business establishments within a radius (0.05–50 km) of a lat/lon coordinate. Optionally filter by APE/NAF sector code. Returns SIREN, denomination, addresses, and sector codes for each nearby unit.

ape.description: Filter to a specific APE/NAF code
